verdict.rationale: Gitea can be driven without its web UI in three first-party ways: the official `tea` CLI, an API for building custom workflows, and its own GitHub Actions-compatible CI (Gitea Actions) with Kubernetes autoscaling runners. The evidence is mostly one-line claims, though, and gives little detail on how headless use actually works. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or token-based auth for CI use, `tea` CLI usage depth (scriptable flags, output formats), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (the docs-path probes returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of headless/CI automation.
